properties.title: NRC Report: Waste Oil in Internal Property Ditch (No Name near Mt. Vernon, IN
properties.summary: Incident Type: PIPELINE - NRC Report ID: 939922 - Medium Affected: WATER - Suspected Responsible Party: CONTRYMARK REFINERY
properties.content:
NRC Report ID: 939922
Incident Time: 2010-05-12 12:45:00
Nearest City: Mt. Vernon, IN
Incident Type: PIPELINE
Material: WASTE OIL
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: CONTRYMARK REFINERY
Skytruth Analysis
Reported Sheen Size: 1 feet by 200 feet (area 200 sq. ft.)
Reported Spill Volume: 5 gallons
Skytruth Minimum Possible Spill Volume: 0 gallons
AT AROUND 7:45 AM 5/12/10 IT WAS NOTED THAT AN UNDERGROUND SLOP OIL LINE HAD DEVELOPED A LEAK. THE LINE WAS IMMEDIATELY SHUT OFF AND PADS/ BOOMS WERE DEPLOYED AS WELL AS VACUUM TRUCKS. THE ABOVE GROUND AREA IMMEDIATELY AROUND THE LEAK AREA RESULTED IN AN SLOP OIL IMPACTION OF A 6' BY 6' AREA OF SOIL ABOUT 1" DEEP. THIS AREA WAS FIRST PADDED OVER WITH ABSORBENT PADS AND IS CURRENTLY BEING EXCAVATED WHICH WILL THEN BE SAMPLED AND DISPOSED OF PROPERLY AT LANDFILL. SIMULTANEOUSLY THE MATERIAL HAD TRICKLED INTO THE NEARBY DITCH THAT RUNS NORTH/SOUTH ON THE PROPERTY. THE DITCH WHICH PRESENTLY CONTAINS WATER WAS MINUTELY IMPACTED RESULTING IN A VERY FINE SHEEN THAT HAS RAN ALONG THE COURSE OF THE WATER THROUGH THE PROPERTY UP TO THE EXISTING SYPHON DAM LOCATED ON THE SOUTH END OF THE PROPERTY. EMERGENCY RESPONSE ACTIVITIES FOR THE DITCH HAVE INCLUDED BOOM DEPLOYMENT AND UTILIZATION OF THE COMPANY VACUUM TRUCK TO COLLECT THE SHEEN IMPACTED WATER AND ENSURE THAT THE MATERIAL REMAINED ON SITE. THE COLLECTED SHEEN WATER WILL BE INTRODUCED BACK INTO OUR WASTE WATER TREATMENT PLANT. SECONDARY ACTIVITIES WILL CONSIST OF DIGGING UP THE LINE AND REPAIRING THE LEAK. REMOVAL OF IMPACTED SOIL AND PROPER DISPOSAL OF THIS MATERIAL AS WELL AS THE PADS & BOOMS. CAREFUL REVIEW INDICATES THAT A TOTAL OF FIVE (5) GALLONS WAS RELEASED WITH A SMALL AMOUNT APPROXIMATELY ONE (1) GALLON ACTUALLY ENTERING THE DITCH THUS THE REASONING BEHIND SUCH A VERY FINE SHEEN. MATERIAL DID NOT LEAVE THE FACILITY GROUNDS VIA SOIL OR WATERWAY. NEARBY PROPERTIES, MILL CREEK AND/OR THE OHIO RIVER BEYOND WERE NOT AFFECTED.
